text:
marta_cs: Quick week0 check-in for CourierLane private deploy — smoke tests mostly green but audit logs aren't appearing in their Splunk collector. Suspect KMS key policy or cross-account IAM. @bob_courierlane can you confirm the collector account ID?

bob_courierlane: collector account is 9876543210. We configured the forwarder last night. No errors on our side. Seeing successful delivery to S3 but no events in Splunk index.

omar_infra: Did you confirm the KMS key policy allows decrypt/grant to 9876543210? Often the key is region-restricted. Also check if the envelope key is customer-managed vs ephemeral.

bob_courierlane: KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11-bb22-cc33. I thought we added the policy from the onboarding checklist but can re-check.

kai_engineer: Paste of a minimal KMS policy we've used in similar setups:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "Allow use by forwarder",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/splunk-forwarder"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

leila_support: Also check our agent config — if prefix sampling is enabled we only send a subset of events to Splunk. In the Console under Observability > Audit export there's a sampling slider. Could be set to 0.

marta_cs: Good catches. Action items: 1) @bob_courierlane verify KMS key policy includes the forwarder role (omitted actions cause S3 objects to be encrypted but unreadable by Splunk), 2) @bob_courierlane & @omar_infra confirm audit export sampling > 0, 3) @kai_engineer to share a short runbook snippet for troubleshooting, 4) I'll capture this as a blocker on the week0 health scorecard.

opsbot: New ticket created: CS-4521 — "CourierLane: Splunk ingestion missing — KMS/IAM check" (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4521)

bob_courierlane: On it, I can update key policy and ping when done. ETA ~40m. One question — will changing key policy impact other producers?

omar_infra: Should be fine as long as you scope the Principal to the forwarder role and avoid wildcard principals. If you need to test without risk, add a temporary statement and remove later.

kai_engineer: Runbook snippet for checking encrypted S3 objects:```sh
# validate object can be decrypted with our CMK
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-bucket/path/to/object - | hexdump -C | head
# try decrypt against kms key
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://object.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > /tmp/decrypted_log
```

leila_support: Also flagging a renewal risk note: if Splunk ingestion continues to be flaky we should expect a customer escalation that could surface as a renewal concern. Recommend we log impact in the account health doc and propose a short runbook session with their SRE next week.

marta_cs: Agreed — I've updated the week0 health doc and added a renewal-risk flag (minor) with mitigation: scheduled runbook + 2-week follow-up. Linking: https://redwood.internal/accounts/courierlane/health/week0

bob_courierlane: Policy updated, forwarder role can decrypt. I ran a small replay and events showed up in Splunk. Looks like sampling was at 0 — we bumped to 5%. Monitoring now.

omar_infra: Great — can you confirm any errors in CloudTrail/KMS logs? We want to capture the failure signature for future triage.

bob_courierlane: No KMS Deny entries in CloudTrail. The only clue was zero objects forwarded due to sampling config. I'll add a note to our internal runbook.

kai_engineer: I'll add the KMS policy example and the decrypt check as a short snippet to the private-deploy runbook page.

marta_cs: Thanks everyone. Closing blocker in CS-4521 and marking week0 status as "yellow" with low renewal risk. Follow-up: 2-week validation and quick runbook call scheduled for Thu 14:00 PT. :calendar:

leila_support: Adding postmortem note to onboarding retro doc: "Sampling default caused missing audit events — ensure sampling default = 5% for first 72h on new installs."

bob_courierlane: Appreciate the triage. Will ping if anything else pops up.
